stock.description: NVC International Holdings Limited, along with its subsidiaries, is dedicated to the manufacturing and global sales of a wide array of lighting products. Its diverse offerings include lamps, luminaires, various lighting electronic devices, and associated components, which are distributed across China, the United States, Japan, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and numerous other international markets. The company provides a comprehensive selection of interior lighting solutions, such as strip lights, spotlights, downlights, track lighting, panel lights, fluorescent fixtures, ceiling and wall-mounted lights, general lamps, linear illumination, and power drivers. For exterior environments, its offerings include floodlights, in-ground lights, underwater lights, bollard lights, post-top luminaires, surface and recessed wall lights, under-canopy lighting, and specialized lighting controllers and drivers. These products are utilized across a variety of applications, spanning commercial, emergency, industrial, office, traditional, and residential settings. Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Tai Po, Hong Kong, the company changed its name from NVC Lighting Holding Limited to its current NVC International Holdings Limited in January 2020.
